name: checkbox-row
title: Checkbox Row
description: CheckboxRow: a UI SDK Checkbox with its label, an optional description and a trailing slot (a badge, a fingerprint, a menu), wired by a UI SDK Field. The whole label toggles it; disabled takes a reason, shown under the label and describing the checkbox. 44px rows on touch, at both densities.
docs:
`<CheckboxRow label="Email me a weekly summary" description="Sent on Monday mornings." trailing={<Badge>Beta</Badge>} checked={checked} onCheckedChange={setChecked} />`.

Every Checkbox prop (`checked`, `defaultChecked`, `onCheckedChange`, `name`, `value`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the checkbox; `className` goes to the row and can be a function of its state. `label` names the checkbox and pressing it toggles it; `description` describes it (`aria-describedby`). `trailing` sits at the end, centred, for a badge, a `SecretFingerprint` or a menu.

`disabled` is `true`, or `{ reason }`: the checkbox turns off, the reason shows under the label and joins the description, so a screen reader hears why. On a coarse pointer the row grows to 44px and the checkbox keeps its 44px hit area (`touch-target`). Field already lays out a checkbox beside its label (`<Field><Checkbox /><FieldLabel /></Field>`); CheckboxRow adds the trailing slot and the disabled reason, and is what SecretList and DeviceApproval build on.
